wire_rule_amended.reason: integrator decision (option b): a deleted role row would make the formal bivariant at the consumer and let a lifetime be extended through an imported type, a soundness hole rather than a conservative loss, so it cannot be recorded as a known limit
wire_rule_amended.rule: every consumer computes each imported nominal header's formal variances from its own field layouts and rejects a bivariant type or lifetime formal as a transport integrity failure on the import, not as a user diagnostic; const formals are exempt, as in rustc; only the declaration bound to the re-proved PhantomData role is exempt. The cost is linear in each header's field types

found_false_rejection.observed: a fresh consumer of a provider with no lifetime-generic nominal fails to lower a local holding a unit value of an imported type-generic nominal with `generic aggregate requires instantiated fields`: the gate provider's `let _m: base::PhantomData<u8> = base::PhantomData;` on this slice's candidate, and `let _o: base::Opt<u8> = base::Opt::None;` against `spec/source-nominals/provider.rs` lines 1-57 plus `pub enum Opt<T> { None, Some(T) }` already on the joined-main CLI (sha 93651a06); explorations in obj/parallel/phantom/explore/gate3-gate7
found_false_rejection.cause: `definition_cells::regional_nominals` sets the consumer's nominal-requirement flag only for an imported nominal with a lifetime, while a local nominal with any formal or own clause sets it; without the flag no body prepares the storage of a unit value, which has no call or literal that would prepare it, and lowering's layout query finds no instance
found_false_rejection.rule: an imported nominal with a lifetime or type formal, or an own clause, sets the flag, exactly as a local one does; consumers of type-generic-only providers therefore also run the nominal bound proofs (integrator decision)
